And those around her think she is as stunning as a princess. Her prince charming is Shan Liang (Alan Yu), whom she has known since childhood. He is also a self-made man: He founded a dating app that went on to become a huge success – and is now a wealthy businessman. When they decide to marry, Wen Yi expects the wedding and subsequent marriage to be a bed of roses. But it proves to be anything but. All of a sudden, she finds herself dragged back into the kind of mundane concerns that she used to deal with before she became a top designer. Can this duo pull through when the going gets tough?

Yoon Tae Yi holds the key to uncovering the secrets of time travel. After encountering Park Jin Gyeom who argues that they met by fate, Yoon Tae Yi joins him in uncovering the secrets. Ekim, Bekir, and Ayse are chosen to start their fresh student life in the city’s most prestigious school, but they soon understand that their life is actually about to get harder; they will have to fight to survive among the rich children and they will be surprised to see that the wealthy have very different lives to what they imagined.

nativeTitle: A Robot in the Orange Orchard (தமிழ் Dubbed)
synopsis: Lu Kun, chairman of the ’emu’ technology company, suffers from a rare illness. When he touches a person, he suffers an allergic reaction. Suddenly, Eun Dan-O has short-term memory loss and she can see what will happen in the near future. She gets confused by her symptoms. Then, Jinmiche, from the school cafeteria, tells Eun Dan-O that she is a character in the comic “Secret” like everybody else there. Eun Dan-O learns that her character is not even a main character, but rather an extra and she doesn’t have much time to live. Eun Dan-O is stunned, but she decides she wants to find her own true first love and not someone written by the comic writer. One day, she falls down the school stairs. She feels her back touch the back of another student, among a group of male students. Her heart suddenly starts to flutter. Eun Dan-O wants to find the male student who made her heart flutter. She eventually finds the student (Ro Woon) and he is her classmate. He is a character that doesn’t have a name. They get close and Eun Dan-O names him “Ha-Roo.”

However, he feels something that he never felt before when meeting Hae Yi at the cheerleading squad. The future of Theia and the relationships of these young students will unravel soon

title: My Princess
synopsis: Kim Tae-hee plays Lee Seol, an ordinary college student who finds out she’s a princess and the great grand daughter of the Korea’s last Emperor. But life can be complicated for a princess in this funny, quirky melodrama.

title: Lost Romance (Season 1)
synopsis: If developing a crush on the CEO (Marcus Chang) of a company wasn’t enough for Zheng Xiao-En, an editor of romance novels, she gets pulled inside one with the same CEO, after she accidentally witnesses a murder attempt on him.

title: My Sassy Girl
synopsis: A love story of a cold city scholar Gyun Woo (Joo Won), who’s known as “Joseon’s national treasure”, and the sassy princess Hye Myung (Oh Yeon-Seo) in a Joseon Dynasty era.

title: Hyde Jekyll Me (Season 1)
synopsis: Koo Seo-Jin (Hyun-Bin) has two different personalities. One of his personalities is cold like Hyde and the other is sweet like Jekyll. He works as the director of theme park Wonderland. Jang Ha-Na (Han Ji-Min) works as the master and actress of a circus at Wonderland. Koo Seo-Jin tries to kick the circus out of Wonderland and Jang Ha-Na reorganizes the circus to stay. In the process, Jang Ha-Na falls in love with Koo Seo-Jin.

title: Hello Again!
synopsis: Chang Ke-Ai, a top student in high school, was forced to withdraw offer from top university due to debt burden. After 10 years, Ke-Ai becomes a seller in market. Her ex-enemy decides to pay back all debts but she needs to work under him.

title: I Swim
synopsis: This is a story of rivalry and friendship between two young swimmers; a tale of natural talent versus hard work. Talented swimmer Chung is a transfer student. In his new class, 4C, he meets a swim relay team led by Wing. Despite being proficient in all four styles, Wing is frustrated at his team’s losing streak to Class 4A. At his first swimming gala, Chung plans to show off his skills. Unfortunately, he shows his imperfect starting dives and lack of stamina instead. The mistake he makes in his starting dive even causes his team to lose. After the defeat, he decides to quit the relay match. However, after observing Chung’s freestyle performance, Wing starts teaching him techniques in starting dives and racing. Wing aims to beat Class 4A with the same team members, including Chung.

title: Castle In The Time (Season-1)
synopsis: Paleontology student Xu Zhen joins Jiang Ye Entertainment to mend family ties, encounters actor Gu Chi Jun, becomes his assistant, and unravels a company conspiracy, risking her safety.

title: Antique 2008
synopsis: Jin-hyeok opens a cake shop in an old antique shop, hiring Seon-woo, Korea’s best pastry chef, who fell in love with him in high school. Also there, are Su-young, crushing on Seon-woo, ex-boxer Ki-beom, and Seon-woo’s French ex-boyfriend.

title: My Star Bride
synopsis: A smalltown girl leaves her home to search for her long-lost sister but instead melts the heart of a handicapped lawyer

title: Love With Flaws
synopsis: A romantic comedy about a woman who has an aversion for flower boys and a man who has an obsession with appearance as they overcome the prejudices against people with flaws.

title: Please Don’t Date Him
synopsis: Due to a marvelous coincidence, a AI developer named Cho Sang Shin, that working on a freshness assessment program, accidentally deploy an innovation tool which can identify nasty men. Using the program capabilities she helps women to get rid of terrible boyfriends. When Ji Son meet a brave fireman named Jung Gook Hee, the program doesn’t identify any important information about the man.

title: Radiant Office
synopsis: An office romantic-comedy features the hijinks that ensues between a tempt worker with possible terminally-ill diagnosis and a prickly elite marketing director.

title: The Most Beautiful You In The World
nativeTitle: The Most Beautiful You In The World (தமிழ் Dubbed)
synopsis: A goddess and a god of a dubbing club fall in love (not really, it’s just a simple love story between a boy who loves the girl since they were kids).

title: Joseon Attorney: A Morality
synopsis: A fusion historical drama that combines romance and legal heroes, and contains a fictional story based on the motif of Gyeongguk Daejeon.
